result.summary: The main content area, specifically the 'Popular right now' section, contains a broken loading indicator or placeholder image that overlays the food imagery, potentially obstructing the UI component's intended visual.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar promotional card contains a prominent white loading spinner overlaying the food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset for the restaurant has loaded correctly. If it's a persistent overlay, review the CSS/layout logic to ensure loading indicators are hidden once the image has rendered.

issues.description: The delivery time label on the 'Fastest near you' cards appears slightly crowded against the image container, affecting readability.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or margins of the time label to ensure proper whitespace between the label background and the image elements.
